text.en: Look closely at the red circle: this bone says 五月, “in the fifth month”. The diviner Zheng carved it about 3,200 years ago.
text.zhs: 看红圈里：这块牛骨上写着“五月”。约3200年前，占卜师“争”刻下了它。

text.en: You can also spot 月 circled in red on this ink rubbing of the Da Yu ding (about 3,000 years old), in the opening words “隹九月” — in the ninth month (column 1)!
text.zhs: 在这张约3000年前的大盂鼎铭文拓片上，你也能在红圈里找到“月”字——就在第1行开头的“隹九月”（在九月）里！
